report_name: Ransomware Attacks Reached Record High in August 2026, NCC Group Finds

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: The most active ransomware group in August 2026, responsible for 15% of attributable attacks. The group is known for its double-extortion tactics, where they encrypt and steal data, threatening to publish it on their data leak site. They target a wide range of industries, with a focus on the industrial and healthcare sectors.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A previously dominant ransomware group that was less active in August 2026, being overtaken by the Qilin group.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups like Qilin encrypt victim data to disrupt operations and extort payment.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups, including Qilin, steal data and threaten to publish it as part of double-extortion tactics. This involves exfiltrating large amounts of data before encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Mentioned as a common initial access vector for ransomware groups.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Mentioned as a common initial access vector for ransomware groups, involving the exploitation of vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Abuse of RDP is cited as a common lateral movement technique used by ransomware groups.

attack_patterns.name: Archive via Utility
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware actors stage data for exfiltration by creating large archive files using utilities like 7-Zip.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware actors delete volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent system recovery.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: A ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation used by the Qilin threat actor group. It employs double-extortion tactics, encrypting files and exfiltrating data for publication on a leak site.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: Mentioned as a common tool used by ransomware groups for lateral movement.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: Mentioned as a common command and control framework used by ransomware groups for lateral movement, with its beacons being a key indicator to monitor.

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.description: Archiving utility mentioned as being used by ransomware actors to stage data into large archive files before exfiltration.

identities.name: Boston Dynamics
identities.description: A high-profile entity mentioned as a victim of a ransomware attack, illustrating the broad targeting of organizations.

identities.name: Manchester Airports Group
identities.description: A high-profile entity mentioned as a victim of a ransomware attack, illustrating the broad targeting of organizations.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A data leak site operated by the Qilin ransomware group to publish stolen victim data as part of their double-extortion strategy.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c55a53e-51e8-4191-98ac-83519fbed59e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.nccgroup.com/newsroom/ncc-group-monthly-threat-pulse-review-of-august/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-23
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of `vssadmin delete shadows`, a command commonly used by ransomware to prevent system recovery.

indicators.name: Data Archiving with 7-Zip for Exfiltration
indicators.pattern:
title: Data Archiving with 7-Zip for Exfiltration
id: 1a9b8c7d-6f5e-4d3c-2b1a-0987654321fe
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 7-Zip (7z.exe) to create large archives, which is often a precursor to data exfiltration by ransomware groups.
references:
  - https://www.nccgroup.com/newsroom/ncc-group-monthly-threat-pulse-review-of-august/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-23
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\7z.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' a '
  filter_legit_path:
    CurrentDirectory|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_path
indicators.description: Detects the use of the 7-Zip utility to create archive files, a common technique for data staging before exfiltration.

indicators.name: 7-Zip Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: 7-Zip Execution
id: 5e4d3c2b-1a09-4876-5432-1fedcba98765
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of 7-Zip (7z.exe), which can be used by adversaries for data staging.
references:
  - https://www.nccgroup.com/newsroom/ncc-group-monthly-threat-pulse-review-of-august/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-23
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
level: low
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\7z.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 7z.exe, a legitimate tool often abused by attackers for data compression and staging.
